name: Horns of Nez'ra
label: Quest
description: Horns of Nez'ra: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many years ago, the Horns of Nez'ra were stolen from Ravenholdt manor. Across continents and oceans I have searched, only to discover that these insignificant beasts have had it in their possession all along.
Slay every Blackrock orc you cross until the Horns of Nez'ra are recovered. Should you recover the horns, find me in Lakeshire.
Do this for me and your name shall be known to Ravenholdt, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the demon prince's horns?

clips.title: Completion
paras: To deny Ravenholdt the artifact, would be to deny one's own existence. Well done, rogue. You may yet walk among the assassins of Ravenholdt.

As a young rogue adventuring in Darkshore, I discovered a tea that replenishes energy in combat. It has served me well throughout the years and now I pass on a taste of the thistle tea to you. Drink of it when you tire, friend, and fight with vigor once more!
